visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a light blue patterned short-sleeved shirt, stands behind a high white counter in a modern studio environment. He gestures animatedly toward the camera, pointing and smiling. To his left is a wooden sign featuring cartoon children and the brand name '媽爹講故事'. (2) The scene transitions to a colorful digital screen recording of a mobile application interface. It shows a large bird mascot with children in a park. The interface then shifts to a login and registration page with a prominent purple '註冊會員' button. (3) The man reappears in the studio, now holding a black mug. Three floating graphic icons representing smartphone screens with subscription plans ('半年卡', '年卡', '兩年卡') appear in front of him as he talks and gestures. (4) A full-screen graphic comparison table titled '官網限定回饋方案' appears, detailing pricing and membership benefits in a clean, grid-like layout with various icons and colors. (5) The man is back on screen, holding up a square graphic poster for a new series titled '媽爹講三國', which has stylized, colorful character illustrations. He points to his head and nods enthusiastically. (6) The video ends with a festive full-screen promotional graphic featuring the bird mascot, two children with balloons, and text indicating a promotion period from 12/1 to 1/6.

It uses an energetic host and interactive dialogue to announce the expansion of membership options and a upcoming new series, creating a sense of value and excitement for the brand's community.
